applyTo:
  - docs/**
  - README.md

Docs instructions
- Keep documentation accurate and concise. Docs are the first-class source for architecture and setup.
- `docs/setup.md` must provide precise commands that work with the `Makefile` and `scripts/bootstrap.sh`.
- Use ADR-style decision notes in `docs/decisions.md` when making project-level choices.
- Update `docs/repo-map.md` when adding or moving top-level folders.
